baslik: 163 Palestinians killed by Israeli forces across West Bank since Oct. 7
metin:
The Palestinian Health Ministry reported that 163 Palestinians have been killed by Israeli attacks in the West Bank since October 7. According to the ministry's statement, the broader figure for 2023 shows "371 Palestinians across the West Bank have been killed by Israeli forces."

The casualty figures extend beyond fatalities. The ministry previously disclosed that injury numbers from the same period "exceeded 2,200" Palestinians in the West Bank.

The escalation of violence coincided with fighting that erupted on October 7 between Palestinian groups and Israel, originating in Gaza. This conflict has created heightened tensions throughout the West Bank region.
